lines.en: if gpmexi == True:
scene gpmexi1 with dissolve
: Hmm...
scene gpmexi2 with dissolve
: What’s wrong, Akira? We’ve already been over here.
lines.zh: : 怎么了，Akira？我们已经来过这边了。

lines.en: : You’re not lost already, are you?
lines.zh: : 你该不会已经迷路了吧？

lines.en: : Of course not. I know exactly what I’m doing.
lines.zh: : 当然没有。我清楚得很自己在干什么。

lines.en: else:
scene gpmexi1 with dissolve2
$ renpy.pause(2, hard=True)
scene gpmexi2 with dissolve2
: Holy smokes! Is that decrepit and forgotten rectangle over there what I {i}think{/i} it is?
lines.zh: : 我的天！那边那个破旧又被遗忘的长方形，是不是我{i}以为{/i}的那个东西？

lines.en: : What do you think it is?
lines.zh: : 你觉得它是什么？

lines.en: : Cheese!
lines.zh: : 茄子！

lines.en: : Then no, Amy. I believe that is a door.
lines.zh: : 那就不是，Amy。我认为那是一扇门。

lines.en: : Ah, you know what? Now that I’m looking a little closer, I can definitely see it.
lines.zh: : 啊，你知道吗？我现在凑近一点看，确实能看出来了。

lines.en: : Guess I’m just a little too hungry to be looking at rectangles! Hahaha!
lines.zh: : 看来我只是太饿了，饿到看不了长方形！哈哈哈！

lines.en: : Well, this is a mall. So we’ll probably bump into a concession stand sooner or later.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这里是商场。所以我们迟早会碰到一个餐饮摊的。

lines.en: : Oh, there’s no need!
lines.zh: : 哦，没必要！

lines.en: scene gpmexi3
: Remember that plaque I read when we first got here? It said the entire Blissful Biosphere is edible! Except for the parts that aren’t.
lines.zh: : 记得我们刚到的时候我读的那块牌子吗？上面说整个极乐生物圈都是可以吃的！除了那些不能吃的部分。

lines.en: : It never really specified what those parts are, though. So I guess there’s a little bit of guessing involved.
lines.zh: : 不过它从没明确说那些部分是哪些。所以我想得稍微猜一猜。

lines.en: : I imagine flowers should be safe, right? They’re made of organic matter, aren’t they?
lines.zh: : 我猜花应该是安全的，对吧？它们是有机物做的，不是吗？

lines.en: : Sure, but so are humans and I wouldn’t recommend eating them.
lines.zh: : 当然，但人也是有机物，而我不会推荐吃人。

lines.en: : I mean, if you’re {i}volunteering{/i} to let me eat you, I can promise I’d only take a {i}little{/i} bite. Of something that would grow back! Hahaha!
lines.zh: : 我是说，如果你{i}自愿{/i}让我吃你，我可以保证我只咬{i}一小口{/i}。咬会重新长出来的地方！哈哈哈！

lines.en: : I wasn’t volunteering for that at all. In fact, that’s basically the opposite of what I said.
lines.zh: : 我根本没有自愿那个。事实上，那跟我说的基本上正好相反。

lines.en: : Aww, really? But I’d let you eat whatever part of me you’d want if you were starving! I bet it would slide right off without any issue either!
lines.zh: : 哎呀，真的？但如果你快饿死了，我会让你吃我身上你想吃的任何部位！我打赌它还会毫无问题地整块滑下来！

lines.en: : I’ll just wait until we find a food court. But you can go ahead and eat the flowers if it makes you happy.
lines.zh: : 我还是等到我们找到美食广场吧。但如果吃花让你开心，你可以去吃。

lines.en: : Okay! Wait right there. I’m gonna find a really big one!
lines.zh: : 好！你在这儿等着。我去找一朵特别大的！

lines.en: scene gpmexi1 with hpunch
Amy runs off and starts picking flowers out of the ground with her teeth. And I can’t help but take pride in the fact that her dental hygiene is what it is because of me.
lines.zh: Amy 跑开了，开始用牙把花从地里拔出来。而我不禁为她如今的牙齿卫生状况是由我造成的而感到自豪。

lines.en: You’re welcome, Amy. I hope you enjoy the flora.
lines.zh: 不用谢，Amy。希望你享用这些植物。

lines.en: : Akira! Akira! I found one! I’m gonna take a bite out of it! Are you ready?!
lines.zh: : Akira！Akira！我找到一朵了！我要咬一口！你准备好了吗？！

lines.en: : Why would I need to be ready? We don’t share a-
lines.zh: : 我为什么需要准备好？我们又没共享一个——

lines.en: scene gpmexi4
: Woaaaaaaah........
lines.zh: : Woaaaaaaah........

lines.en: : Whaaaaaat’s.......haaaaappening??????
scene gpmexi5
: Akiraaaaaaa!!!! The floooower was a hallucinogeeeeeniiiiic!!!!!
lines.zh: : Akiraaaaaaa！！！！那朵花花花花是致幻剂啊啊啊啊啊！！！！

lines.en: : Loooooook at my skiiiiiiin! It’s so briiiiiiight!
lines.zh: : 快看我的皮肤肤肤肤！好亮亮亮亮啊！

lines.en: : But...why am I high too?! That’s not how this is supposed to work!
lines.zh: : 可……为什么我也嗨了？！这不该是这么运作的！

lines.en: : It must be a Room of Shared Consumption! I thought these were illegal! There’s probably some kind of frog law that allows it!
lines.zh: : 这一定是「共享摄食室」！我还以为这些是非法的！大概有什么青蛙法律允许它吧！

lines.en: : A Room of...Shaaaaared Consumption?
lines.zh: : 「共享……享享享摄食室」？

lines.en: : That’s right! A few decades ago, the government started cracking down on drugs {i}really{/i} hard! But it was making too many people sad, so they created a new type of business as a solution!
lines.zh: : 没错！几十年前，政府开始{i}非常{/i}严厉地打击毒品！但那让太多人难过，所以他们创造了一种新型生意作为解决办法！

lines.en: : The Room of Shared Consumption is a small enclosed space where everyone’s internal systems are linked. Meaning if one person eats or drinks something, everyone else in the room shares the benefits!
lines.zh: : 共享摄食室是一个封闭的小空间，里面所有人的内部系统都是连通的。也就是说，如果一个人吃了或喝了什么，房间里的其他人都会共享它的效果！

lines.en: : It helped solve the overcrowding of orphanages too when the government bought up basically every single child and strapped them all to special chairs inside of these rooms.
lines.zh: : 它还顺便解决了孤儿院过度拥挤的问题，当时政府几乎把所有孩子都买了下来，把他们绑在这些房间里的特制椅子上。

lines.en: : After that, they’d feed them all {i}types{/i} of drugs on an hourly basis and anyone who entered the room could share the effects of it without worrying about the long-term effects on their bodies.
lines.zh: : 在那之后，他们每小时都给这些孩子喂{i}各种{/i}毒品，而任何进入房间的人都能共享它的效果，还不用担心对自己身体有长期影响。

lines.en: : Overdoses dropped by nearly 100%%! The only downside was it became harder for couples to adopt children since all the orphans were gone. Cool, right?
lines.zh: : 用药过量的案例下降了将近 100%%！唯一的缺点是，因为孤儿全没了，夫妻想收养孩子变得更难了。很酷吧？

lines.en: : I guess. I’m starting to understand why those rooms were outlawed, though.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。不过我开始明白那些房间为什么被禁了。

lines.en: scene gpmexi2
: Yeah. Not exactly the most morally great thing humans have ever done. It beats the vore room, though!
lines.zh: : 是啊。不算是人类做过的最道德高尚的事。不过总比「吞食室」强！

lines.en: : The what?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : I don’t want to talk about it. I learned too many things about myself that day.
lines.zh: : 我不想谈那个。那天我对自己了解到了太多东西。

lines.en: : Are you still high?
lines.zh: : 你还嗨着吗？

lines.en: : No, I think I’m good now.
lines.zh: : 不，我想我现在好了。

lines.en: : Great! Let’s keep going then!
lines.zh: : 太好了！那我们继续走吧！
